jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support Airbus Defence and Space we are looking for a

**M&P Surface Technology Engineer (d/f/m) **

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

**Your location **

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

**Our Benefits for You **

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

**Your tasks and responsibilities **

- Support to acquisition and execution of technology, development and qualification projects in the area of surface technologies, functional coatings and corrosion protection
- Preparation of material and process specifications as well as process and test instructions
- Support to obsolescence management and change requests
- Support to environmental compliance (REACH regulation) programs
- Consultancy to design, stress, quality and manufacturing for materials and process related enquiries
- Collaboration with external institutes
- Steering and collaboration with material suppliers
- Provide expertise support for engineering, manufacturing and in-service issues on Surface technologies.
- Development and harmonization of technologies for external livery applications (paints, materials, processes), pre-treatment and cleaning technologies for surface preparation.

**Desired skills and qualifications **

- Master degree or PhD in material science, chemistry or aerospace engineering
- Experience in surface and coatings technologies as well as corrosion protection mandatory
- Experience in aerospace industry and its related processes such as qualification, certification and standardisation preferred
- German and English Negotiation level mandatory
- Ability to work in a transnational team
- Independent and proactive working style

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

- Confident communicator – able to produce high-quality strategic content and engage credibly with senior stakeholders, both verbally and in writing
- Leadership ambition – this role offers a clear development path for those who want to grow into a broader scope
- Comfortable working across cultures, functions and global locations
- Business-fluent in English, German is a strong plus

- Attractive compensation – in addition to a competitive salary package, you’ll benefit from comprehensive benefits offered by a responsible family-owned company

In order to support our “Technical Certification Team”, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Electronics and/or military Avionics Designated Airworthiness Engineer (d/f/m)

This team provides certification expertise across all Airbus Defence and Space aircraft programs and represents Airbus Defence and Space in rulemaking and international industrial standardisation working groups.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Lead the certification, qualification and Continued Airworthiness activities for the Electronics and/or Military Avionics technical disciplines.
- Provide airworthiness approvals and exercise Design Organisations Approvals (DOA) as well as Military Design Organisation Approvals (MDOA) privileges for the scope of assigned responsibility as delegated by the Office of Chief of Airworthiness.
- Be responsible for the timely achievement of certification and qualification milestones through identification of major program technical issues and associated risk management plan, identification of regulation and interpretation issues and identification of safety and certification compliance issues.
- Lead the necessary activities for the investigation of incidents and accidents for those aspects regarding Airworthiness technical knowledge.
- Provide technical certification knowledge in Electronics and/or Military Avionics to the design organization, or special projects.
- Influence the definition of certification policies for the technical discipline under his/her scope, and promote their consistent application across programs, including the participation in the development of new and foreseen technical certification strategies or policies. In particular for novel or unusual design features or for compliance demonstration method improvement.
- Represent Airbus Defence and Space in rulemaking and international industrial standardisation working groups for technical certification.
- Contribute to technical certification de-risking in Airbus Defence and Space Research and Technology (R&T) as well as Research and Development (R&D) projects related to the Airworthiness Technical.
- Gather and disseminate Technical Certification regulatory knowledge and expertise within Airbus Defence and Space, particularly for Compliance Verification Engineers (CVE) and Designated Airworthiness Engineer (DAE) community, to maintain state of the art.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Master’s or Bachelor’s Degree in Aerospace Engineering.
- Extensive professional experience (more than 10 years) in Airworthiness functions related to Electronics and/or Military Avionics discipline.
- Experience interfacing with Aviation Authorities is a plus.
- Excellent negotiation skills, strong interpersonal and consulting skills.
- Ability to understand complex issues and break them down in order to develop solutions independently.
- Advanced level of English.
- Good knowledge of German language is a plus.

A Snapshot of Your Day 

As Project Management Office (PMO) Lead, you will establish and drive the operational PMO for the Siemens Energy Real Estate function in Southern Germany, with a particular focus on the Nuremberg Katzwanger Straße site. You will bring structure, transparency, and control to a growing portfolio of real estate initiatives by coordinating projects, aligning stakeholders, monitoring risks and financials, and ensuring compliant execution. Acting as the central interface between internal functions, business units, leadership, and external partners, you will ensure that projects are well coordinated, key decisions are supported by transparent reporting, and initiatives are delivered efficiently, on time, and within budget.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Establish and lead the operational Project Management Office (PMO) for the Siemens Energy Real Estate function in Southern Germany, with a focus on the Nuremberg Katzwanger Straße site.
* Coordinate and manage a growing portfolio of real estate and construction projects, ensuring effective planning, prioritization, risk management, and timely delivery.
* Act as the central interface for internal and external stakeholders, ensuring transparent communication, alignment, and effective collaboration across functions and business units.
* Develop and implement standardized project management processes, methodologies, tools, and reporting structures to increase transparency, consistency, and efficiency across the project portfolio.
* Provide comprehensive portfolio reporting and dashboards for leadership, including project status, risks, dependencies, financial aspects, and key milestones.
* Ensure operationally compliant project execution in line with corporate guidelines, legal requirements, procurement processes, and industry best practices, while supporting vendor management and project documentation.

What You Bring

* Master’s degree in Business Administration, Real Estate Management, Engineering, Architecture, or a related field.
* Extensive experience in project, program, or portfolio management, ideally within a PMO, corporate real estate, construction, or comparable environment. Proven experience in establishing or managing PMO structures and coordinating complex project portfolios.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to effectively align diverse internal and external stakeholders.
* Solid knowledge of project planning, risk management, process improvement, financial management, and reporting.
* A structured, proactive, and solution-oriented approach, combined with strong leadership and organizational skills.
* Professional project management certification such as PMP or PRINCE2 is an advantage.
* Full professional proficiency in German and English.

About the Team

Our global functions provide top-notch services and solutions in areas such as IT, human resources, finance, real estate, strategy, and technology, actively supporting the business.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programs and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.
